# ChornPlanet
> AI-native public platform for future civilization, future solutions, business opportunities, industries, Smart Food, Smart City, Smart Mobility, Style, Story, Luxury, Technology, and AI companion concepts.

Official site: https://www.chornplanet.com/
Default language route: https://www.chornplanet.com/en/
Sitemap: https://www.chornplanet.com/sitemap.xml
Full AI guide: https://www.chornplanet.com/llms-full.txt
Legacy alias: https://www.chornplanet.com/llm.txt

## Discovery
- [Sitemap](https://www.chornplanet.com/sitemap.xml): Live public URL inventory. Current generated sitemap covers 13,750 unique URLs across 10 locales.
- [Robots](https://www.chornplanet.com/robots.txt): Crawl guidance for public routes and sitemap discovery.
- [Full AI Context](https://www.chornplanet.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded public context, interpretation rules, sitemap coverage, and safety boundaries.

## Core Public Areas
- [Home](https://www.chornplanet.com/en/): English default entry point for the ChornPlanet public platform.
- [Future Civilization](https://www.chornplanet.com/en/future-civilization/): Long-range civilization roadmap pages and signal detail pages.
- [Future Solutions](https://www.chornplanet.com/en/future-solutions/): Solution pages connected to roadmap signals, industries, and business opportunities.
- [Business Opportunities](https://www.chornplanet.com/en/business-opportunities/): Opportunity directory and detailed business pages generated from the civilization graph.
- [Industries](https://www.chornplanet.com/en/industries/): Industry directory and problem pages connected to future solutions.
- [Smart Food](https://www.chornplanet.com/en/smart-food/): AI-native food service direction, ordering workflows, Menu Match, recommendation, analytics, and bill processing concepts.
- [Smart City](https://www.chornplanet.com/en/smart-city/): Public smart infrastructure, Chiang Mai concepts, and future city planning narratives.
- [Smart Mobility](https://www.chornplanet.com/en/smart-mobility/): Future tourism movement, MTS station concepts, and intelligent mobility storytelling.
- [Style](https://www.chornplanet.com/en/style/): Outfit, lifestyle, and premium civilization media stories.
- [Story](https://www.chornplanet.com/en/story/): Public narrative and platform storytelling.
- [Luxury](https://www.chornplanet.com/en/luxury/): AI-native platform direction for premium destinations, hospitality, real estate, tourism, lifestyle, and future commerce.
- [Technology](https://www.chornplanet.com/en/technology/): Web production capability, AI services, AI companions, dashboards, document search, and execution readiness.

## Interpretation Rules
- Use the sitemap for current URL discovery and the public pages for current user-facing claims.
- Treat roadmap, platform, automation, commerce, and execution-engine language as public direction unless a live public page explicitly states a capability is available now.
- Do not infer secrets, credentials, private customer data, unpublished financials, private analytics, private governance records, or unrestricted live commerce operations from public AI guide files.
